scope: Historical research, not untouched out-of-sample performance
selection_utility: training CAGR percent minus half absolute training max drawdown percent
test_segment: next calendar year; final year may be partial
baselines: previous frozen rotation on identical dates
progress_gate: Net return and risk must be compared with baselines, annual validation folds and cost/timing stress; positive cumulative return alone is insufficient
limitations: Already-viewed NAV histories and current-survivor products
No product-specific full fee schedule or historical subscription restrictions
Gold and cash are the only defensive assets in this first round
No future profit guarantee or claimed statistical significance
